Gold.return_units_verified: Log-return (additive in cumsum, exponentiated for equity)
Gold.cost_model_verified: 5.0 bps per unit turnover (charged on entry, exit, and flip)

volatility_audit.root_cause_of_0_38_pct_gold_vol: The 0.38% reported volatility was STRATEGY volatility, NOT asset volatility. Because Gold Random Forest was flat (position=0, return=0.0) for 1,610 out of 1,612 bars (99.88% cash), standard deviation of strategy returns was near zero (0.0000938/bar). The actual underlying Gold asset annualized volatility is ~11.6% to 22.4% depending on annualization factor.

sharpe_audit.interpretation: When Rf=6.5% is incorporated, Gold's Sharpe drops to negative because sitting in cash without yielding the risk-free rate incurs an opportunity loss against a 6.5% cash benchmark.

win_rate_audit.flaw_note: Phase 2 calculated win rate as (r > 0).mean() over all bars, including zero-return cash bars. This reported an artificially tiny 0.06% for Gold and 6.05% for Silver. Correct trade-level win rate must evaluate closed trade episodes.

leakage_and_alignment_audit.target_construction: np.log(next_close / close) strictly for consecutive 1-hour bar
leakage_and_alignment_audit.session_gap_handling: elapsed == 1 hour strictly enforced; non-consecutive hours dropped
leakage_and_alignment_audit.train_val_test_integrity: Chronological 70% / 15% / 15% strictly maintained; final test period uncompromised
